sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: Google Research and UNSW Sydney released GlucoFM, a self-supervised foundation model that splits a CGM trace into a slow physiological stream and a transient event stream instead of encoding it as one sequence. At 0.72M parameters it reached 58.8 task-averaged PR-AUC across 14 cohort–task evaluations, beating a 135M GluFormer and a 385M MOMENT. It remains a research prototype with no regulatory clearance. The post Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring appeared first on MarkTechPost .
